items.title: 7.3.2 Impacts of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Digital divide ke asraat afraad aur poore muashre par door tak jate hain. Yeh asraat pehle se maujood na-barabari (inequality) ko mazeed barha (exacerbate) sakte hain aur nayi na-barabari bhi paida kar sakte hain. Agle hisson mein paanch asraat hain: taleem, maeeshat (economy), samaji aur shehri shirakat, sehat aur digital literacy.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide pehle se maujood na-barabari ko kyun barha deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jo log pehle se peeche hain (kam aamdani, dehi ilaqe) wohi online taleem, naukriyon aur sarkari services se bhi mehroom rehte hain, is liye woh rasai rakhne walon se aur peeche reh jate hain.

items: Digital divide purani na-barabari barhata aur nayi paida karta hai: taleem, maeeshat, shehri shirakat, sehat, digital literacy.
